evidence_required: ECMP hashing mechanism; collision explanation; two mitigations with their trade-off.

marking.criterion: Mechanism: source port is the per-QP entropy field hashed by ECMP; one QP stays on one path
Collision explanation: two QPs per pair → few flows; QPNs and ports change run to run, so collisions and bandwidth vary
Two mitigations, each with its trade-off (more QPs, rail-local placement, adaptive routing/spraying)

title: Entropy from the UDP source port
